messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT: realtime-p99-detector triggered for route /v1/generate (prod) — window=5m — p99=5120ms, p95=420ms, error_rate +3.8pp. Paging @derek_oncall.

_derek_oncall has been paged and acknowledged._

derek_oncall: ack — on it. anyone doing deploys? i'll pull traces + check runtime pools.

carla_sre: no deploys from deploy-bot in last 60m. seeing tail spikes on streaming sessions in EU region. starting dashboards and trace aggregation now.

alice_prodeng: can someone check KV cache miss ratio? if prefix/KV thrash that's a common tail pain.

ben_ds: quick look at the SLO dash: baseline p95 ~180ms, current p95 ~380ms, p99 5120ms. big skew from streaming endpoints (/v1/generate-stream). chart: https://dashboards/redwood/p99-live (paste)

derek_oncall: quick checks i'm running: 1) curl health on a few runtime nodes; 2) check model fallback counts; 3) queue depth and backlog on pool-a. post results here.

frank_sre: ran curl -> node runtime-a-12 returned 504 after ~4.8s, runtime-b-04 ok (200).

frank_sre: logs snippet from runtime-a-12:
```
[04:12:14] runtime-a-12 stream stall: kvcache-miss spike=78% err=timeout
[04:12:15] runtime-a-12 resend fragment timeout
[04:12:16] runtime-a-12 queue depth=312 backlog=120
```

carla_sre: confirmed: pool-a kvcache miss rate jumped 4% -> 63% in last 3m. eviction pressure visible — looks like cache thrash due to long prefix reuse.

eve_ops: autoscaler metrics: desired=80 current=64 pending=0. controller logs show repeated 429 on scale requests to infra API, suspect rate-limit or controller bug. digging.

derek_oncall: mitigation plan (fast): 1) shift traffic away from pool-a to pool-b via routing override; 2) enable compact-model fallback for streaming routes (lower memory, faster startup); 3) widen batching window temporarily to reduce per-token kernel pressure. executing now.

alice_prodeng: prepared routing override payload:
```
POST /admin/route-override HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.local
Content-Type: application/json

{ "route": "/v1/generate-stream", "target_pool": "pool-b", "percent": 60 }
```

derek_oncall: applied routing override -> 60% to pool-b. observing metrics... p95 -> 240ms, p99 down to ~900ms within 45s. still watching for stabilizing trend. :thumbsup:

ben_ds: customer-impact estimate: EU dedicated seats saw increased latency and 504s between 04:10-04:16. approx affected requests ~12k (0.02% global). raising for post-incident notif.

carla_sre: opening incident page INC-4842109999, assigning SRE oncall for the next 2 hours for live mitigation. will follow up with root-cause steps once autoscaler/controller logs analyzed.

derek_oncall: next actions: keep routing override for 30m, continue draining pool-a, investigate controller 429s, collect runtime heap/KV evictions, and check streaming client retry behavior.

incident-bot: Incident INC-4842109999 created. @derek_oncall acknowledged. Use /incident update INC-4842109999 for notes.

carla_sre: thanks team — we'll update this thread with timeline + RCA notes. please paste any odd logs/traces here.
